hero.subtitle: Europea i Malmö AB develops and runs ventures within accessible communication, digital accessibility, and user-centred technology solutions. Since 1993 we have worked to reduce communication barriers and create solutions that make accessible communication, information, and digital environments possible for more people.
hero.since_label: Founded in Malmö – active ever since

coreCompetence.label: Europea's position
coreCompetence.heading: Accessibility as a core competence
coreCompetence.lead: Accessibility is not a side track at Europea – it is our core competence. Through specialist knowledge, innovation, and long experience, we develop solutions that strengthen participation, understanding, and equal communication.
coreCompetence.card1_desc: Solutions for voice, text, video, and remote communication that make it possible for more people to take part on their own terms.
coreCompetence.card2_desc: Expertise in WCAG, usability, and digital accessibility – with a focus on practical value for users and organisations.
coreCompetence.card3_desc: Technology and services developed with longevity, interoperability, and future-proof communication solutions in focus.

evolution.label: Our evolution
evolution.heading: From accessible communication to broader accessibility
evolution.lead: Europea's work began within accessible communication through T-Meeting and solutions for people with hearing and communication challenges. In recent years, that work has broadened – from communication to digital accessibility and inclusive digital services.
evolution.body1: The experience gained from accessible communication created a natural path forward toward digital accessibility, usability, and new forms of inclusive technology.
evolution.body2: That evolution is clearly reflected in initiatives such as EaseAccess24 – where the same fundamental conviction lives on: that accessibility should not be an optional extra, but a self-evident part of how technology, communication, and digital services are designed.

brands.label: Our brands
brands.heading: Ventures within Europea
brands.lead: Europea is the company behind several specialised ventures and brands. Together they show the breadth of our expertise within accessible communication, digital accessibility, and user-centred technology.
brands.tmeeting_desc: Accessible communication – built for participation. T-Meeting develops solutions where audio, video, and real-time text work together to create secure, inclusive, and future-proof communication. Our solutions are built on open standards and developed for the public sector, organisations, and individuals.
brands.tmeeting_rtt_body: T-Meeting has reviewed and provided advisory feedback on work related to standardisation for RTT/real-time text. That experience strengthens our work with open standards, interoperability, and future-proof solutions for accessible communication.
brands.ease_desc: EaseAccess24 is Europea's specialist venture within digital accessibility. With a focus on WCAG, usability, and inclusive digital services, the venture helps organisations create websites and digital environments that work for more people.
brands.infiniuum_desc: Infiniuum brings together Europea's effort in complementary perception products. The products build on Europea's development work and are offered to the consumer market, while corresponding solutions via T-Meeting are often provided through the public sector and procurement.

history.label: History
history.heading: Three decades of development within accessibility
history.lead: Since 1993, Europea has evolved from communication aids and video telephony to accessible communication, digital inclusion, and specialist ventures within accessibility.
history.image_note_body: A historic image from Europea's development of digital and mobile video phones can be placed here to visualise the innovation journey from 1993–2010.
history.item1_body: Europea i Malmö AB is founded with a focus on communication aids and accessible solutions for people with hearing impairments and communication difficulties.
history.item2_body: During the first decades, Europea develops and delivers digital and mobile video phones as well as communication aids that strengthen independence and accessible communication.
history.item3_body: T-Meeting is established in its current form with a focus on accessible communication, open standards, and solutions for audio, video, and real-time text.
history.item4_body: Infiniuum is created to give customers access to the best products – and serves as the e-commerce platform within the group.
history.item5_body: EaseAccess24 is established with a focus on digital accessibility and WCAG – a natural next step in Europea's work toward greater participation and inclusive digital services.

company.label: About Europea
company.heading: The company behind our ventures
company.lead: Europea i Malmö AB is the strategic base behind our ventures. We bring together experience, technology, and brands within accessibility – and drive development toward solutions that make communication and digital environments more inclusive.
company.tmeeting_desc: T-Meeting is Europea's specialist brand within accessible communication. Through audio, video, and real-time text, it develops solutions that enable secure, inclusive, and future-proof communication – built on open standards and long experience in the field.
company.ease_desc: EaseAccess24 is Europea's specialist venture within digital accessibility. With a focus on WCAG, usability, and inclusive digital services, the venture helps organisations create websites and digital environments that work for more people.
company.infiniuum_desc: Infiniuum brings together Europea's effort in complementary perception products. The products build on Europea's development work and are offered to the consumer market, while corresponding solutions via T-Meeting are often provided through the public sector and procurement.

vision.label: Vision
vision.heading: A driving force for accessibility in Europe
vision.lead: Europea works toward a society where accessibility is not an optional extra or an exception – but a self-evident part of how communication, technology, and digital services are designed.
vision.vision_body: Our ambition is to be a driving European force within accessibility by using our knowledge, experience, and capacity for innovation to reduce barriers and create real participation – across languages, societal systems, and national borders.
vision.belief_body1: We believe that solutions designed with the most demanding needs in mind create better solutions for everyone.
vision.belief_body2: That is why we see accessibility not only as a question of equality and human rights – but as a driving force for innovation, universal design, and the society of the future.
vision.practice_body: T-Meeting carries Europea's vision within accessible communication through the idea of Komplett Kommunikation – a concept introduced by Faruk and Max Tairi that describes equal access to communication for all.

europe.label: European presence
europe.heading: From the Nordics – with European ambition
europe.lead: Europea has its roots in Malmö and is today actively operating in Sweden and Norway. Through our ventures and collaborations, we also operate internationally – with a subsidiary presence in North Macedonia and ongoing establishment work in France.
europe.body1: Our ambition is clear: to grow as a European force within accessibility, where knowledge, innovation, and practical experience are used to create more inclusive communication and digital environments.
europe.body2: We see accessibility as a shared European matter and want to contribute to the development of solutions that work across languages, borders, and societal systems.

founders.label: The founders
founders.heading: A company built on real understanding of accessibility
founders.lead: Europea i Malmö AB was founded in 1993 by Faruk and Max Tairi, both with backgrounds as language interpreters. Through their work in interpreted conversations, they saw first-hand how communication barriers affect people's ability to understand, take part, and make their own decisions.
founders.body1: That experience became the foundation for Europea's direction and position: to be a practical, knowledgeable, and long-term force within accessibility.
founders.body2: Since the start, the business has grown through specialist knowledge, innovation, and a long-term commitment to accessibility – and today encompasses several ventures and brands with a shared focus on communication, participation, and digital inclusion.
founders.body3: The founders' background in interpreting, entrepreneurship, and high-performance environments has shaped the company's culture: long-term thinking, discipline, and practical problem-solving.
founders.quote: Communication should not be an obstacle to participation – it should be an opportunity.

industry.label: Industry & affiliation
industry.heading: Rooted in the development of accessibility
industry.lead: Europea works long-term with accessibility and participation – in close relation to the industry, user needs, and the development of the accessible solutions of the future.
industry.membership_name: The industry association Branschorganisationen Svensk Tillgänglighet
industry.membership_body: Europea i Malmö AB is a member of the industry association Branschorganisationen Svensk Tillgänglighet and shares the organisation's work for greater participation, knowledge, and development within the field of accessibility.

contact.label: Contact
contact.heading: Want to know more about Europea?
contact.lead: Get in touch if you want to know more about Europea, our ventures, or our work within accessible communication, digital accessibility, and inclusive technology.
